query:
SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'income'), 0) as income,
            COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'expense'), 0) as expense
        FROM transactions
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM transaction_date) = $2
          AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date) = $3
